title: Silver Oak Capital - Commercial Mortgage Broker & Property Development Finance Solutions
h1: NOT REVEALED by search results. Seed records the tagline/positioning 'International Debt Advisory l Expert Finance Solutions' [seed], but whether it is the H1 is unconfirmed.
metaDescription: NOT REVEALED. Only the <title> surfaced (search [b]): 'Silver Oak Capital - Commercial Mortgage Broker & Property Development Finance Solutions'.
summary: Homepage of Silver Oak Capital, a London-based (91 Wimpole Street, W1G) debt advisory / large-loan broker founded in 2019 by Jimmy Baillie. Search [b] returned the homepage with the title 'Silver Oak Capital - Commercial Mortgage Broker & Property Development Finance Solutions' and summarised it as arranging debt across the UK, US, Western Europe and the Middle East through a network of over 800 lenders. Search [a] did not return the homepage itself; it returned third-party directories and other site pages describing the firm (loans roughly GBP 500k to GBP 20m, 700+/300+/500+ lender counts depending on source, services spanning development finance, bridging, commercial and residential mortgages, marine and aviation finance). Search [c] surfaced Spear's and LinkedIn material (UHNW clients, GBP 2m-20m secured loans, 800+ lenders, UK/Western Europe/Southern Africa/Middle East, a GB Bank GBP 3.5m refinance for a Monaco-based expatriate). The homepage body text itself (hero copy, section headings, CTAs) was NOT exposed by any of the three searches; the seed supplies the navigation, the sector list on the home page (retail, office, logistics, care homes, student accommodation, hotels) and the residential line 'Main home mortgages, Buy to Lets, Holiday Lets and HMO's'.

notes: Search [a] (extended, exact URL) did not return the homepage; it returned other site pages and third-party directories. Search [b] (site: query) was the only one to return https://www.silveroakcapital.co.uk/ itself, exposing the page title and the 'UK, US, Western Europe and the Middle East ... over 800 lenders' statement. Search [c] (standard) mostly surfaced Spear's and LinkedIn plus unrelated firms (Silver Point Capital, Cavendish, Deloitte, Knight Frank, Silverfleet Capital in [a]) which were ignored. Verbatim entries tagged [a]/[b]/[c] are the search tool's summary wording, not guaranteed raw page text, except the [b] page title. Contradictions: lender counts 300+/500+/700+/800+; loan ranges 'over £500k' vs '£500k-£20m' vs '£2m-£20m'; postcode W1G 0EE vs W1G 0EF; founding year 2019 (all three searches) vs seed note that one page mentions 2018. Hero copy, H1, meta description, section headings, CTAs, testimonials, awards badges and process steps of the homepage remain unverified. Relayed user request mentioned a 403 error when transferring the folder; this harvesting step was completed via WebSearch only, consistent with the harness note that direct fetching is blocked.
